# Sonoff RF Bridge R2

Capture or transmit user-approved fixed-code 433 MHz actions through a stock Sonoff RF Bridge R2 using Muse Home Link, over its compatible encrypted HTTP zeroconf firmware, with existing device ID/devicekey in approved storage and a private, user-confirmed channel-to-action map (channels 0-15). Fixed codes only: no rolling codes, no key extraction, and the derived AES key never leaves the machine and never appears in commands or logs.
